meta.title: Iminify Image Optimizer
meta.description: The plugin's screens with three sample photos in the media library, before the site is connected.
meta.author: Iminify

steps.data:
<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Iminify preview
 * Description: Keeps this preview from connecting to Iminify. It runs in your browser, and a connection belongs to your own site.
 */

add_filter(
	'pre_http_request',
	static function ( $pre, $args, $url ) {
		if ( class_exists( 'Iminify\WordPress\Api\Client' ) && 0 === strpos( (string) $url, \Iminify\WordPress\Api\Client::base() ) ) {
			return new WP_Error( 'iminify_preview', 'this preview runs in your browser, so it connects to nothing. Install the plugin on your own site to connect it.' );
		}

		return $pre;
	},
	1,
	3
);

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';

$photos = array(
	array( 'Harbour at dawn', array( 255, 196, 150 ), array( 92, 132, 188 ), array( 38, 64, 96 ) ),
	array( 'Hills after rain', array( 190, 220, 240 ), array( 120, 170, 210 ), array( 66, 112, 70 ) ),
	array( 'Desert evening', array( 250, 150, 90 ), array( 120, 70, 120 ), array( 150, 100, 60 ) ),
);

foreach ( $photos as $photo ) {
	list( $title, $top, $bottom, $ground ) = $photo;
	$width  = 1600;
	$height = 1067;
	$image  = imagecreatetruecolor( $width, $height );

	for ( $y = 0; $y < $height; $y++ ) {
		$share = $y / $height;
		$color = imagecolorallocate( $image, (int) ( $top[0] + ( $bottom[0] - $top[0] ) * $share ), (int) ( $top[1] + ( $bottom[1] - $top[1] ) * $share ), (int) ( $top[2] + ( $bottom[2] - $top[2] ) * $share ) );
		imageline( $image, 0, $y, $width, $y, $color );
	}

	imagefilledellipse( $image, 1180, 330, 220, 220, imagecolorallocate( $image, 255, 236, 200 ) );
	imagefilledpolygon( $image, array( 0, 760, 420, 560, 860, 720, 1240, 600, 1600, 700, 1600, 1067, 0, 1067 ), imagecolorallocate( $image, $ground[0], $ground[1], $ground[2] ) );

	ob_start();
	imagejpeg( $image, null, 92 );
	$upload = wp_upload_bits( sanitize_title( $title ) . '.jpg', null, ob_get_clean() );

	$id = wp_insert_attachment(
		array(
			'post_title'     => $title,
			'post_mime_type' => 'image/jpeg',
			'post_status'    => 'inherit',
		),
		$upload['file']
	);

	wp_update_attachment_metadata( $id, wp_generate_attachment_metadata( $id, $upload['file'] ) );
}
